MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The digital caliper feels useful because I could measure electronic components, PCB mounts and furniture hardware across several projects.",
    "The casters connect to my furniture work, and heat shrink connects to my wiring projects, although neither is an immediate choice without checking need and fit."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Heavy battery cable lugs do not fit the small wires and breadboard components I have used; being electrical does not make them interchangeable.",
    "Waterproof tape, epoxy and cutting wheels assume repair or metalworking tasks I have not shown a need for.",
    "Eighteen rolls of tape and fifty size-specific washers are difficult to justify for occasional projects without a concrete use."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in practical project supplies seems to have been stretched into a broad need for workshop and repair products.",
    "My caster purchase seems to have been treated as a reason to buy another set, even though it may already have met that need."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "Exact dimensions and compatibility matter: heat shrink must fit my wires, and connectors must suit the scale of my electronics work.",
    "I choose supplies when a particular project calls for them; a related item is not enough to make me buy now.",
    "A broadly useful measuring tool fits better than a specialized magnetic base that requires a measurement setup I have not indicated owning."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The suggestions recognize my electronics and furniture projects but assume too many new repair needs and repeat purchases."
}
